decision.explanation: The question asks which country the Supreme Electoral Tribunal belongs to. Multiple documents provide direct evidence for distinct instances of the Supreme Electoral Tribunal belonging to specific countries. Document D1S1 and D2S5 confirm the Supreme Electoral Tribunal in Brazil. D4S18 and D4S19 mention the Supreme Electoral Tribunal in Canada. D5S1 identifies the Supreme Electoral Tribunal in Honduras. D7S1 refers to the Supreme Electoral Tribunal in Guatemala. D3S4 mentions Argentina in the context of electronic voting, though less directly. These are treated as distinct valid referents.
